definitions.gloss: legal personality; status as a legal entity
definitions.explanation: The legal standing that lets an organization hold property, sign contracts, and sue in its own name, separately from the people who run it.

examples.japanese: この{団体|だんたい}には{法人格|ほうじんかく}がない。
examples.english: This organization has no legal personality.

examples.japanese: {登記|とうき}によって{法人格|ほうじんかく}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
examples.english: It acquired legal personality through registration.

examples.japanese: {法人格|ほうじんかく}があれば{団体|だんたい}{名義|めいぎ}で{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}いたり{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだりできる。
examples.english: With legal personality, an organization can open accounts and sign contracts in its own name.

notes:
{法人|ほうじん} (juridical person, corporation) + {格|かく} (status, standing). Central to Japanese discussion of NPOs, associations, and companies, since many small groups operate without it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to acquire legal personality
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}のない{団体|だんたい}: an unincorporated body
- {法人格|ほうじんかく}を{持|も}つ: to have legal personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {法人|ほうじん}: legal person, corporation — the entity itself rather than its status
- {権利能力|けんりのうりょく}: capacity to hold rights — the wider legal concept covering individuals too
